clauses.scope_note: GPL-3.0 section 6: Installation Information must accompany Corresponding Source for the specified object-code conveyance and User Product transaction. No duty under this paragraph if neither the conveyor nor any third party can install modified object code on the product.
clauses.condition_explanation: conveys_object_code_work_under_section_6 means the actor conveys object-code work under section 6; work_in_with_or_specifically_for_user_product means it is in, with, or specifically for a User Product; the transaction condition requires transfer of possession and use rights to the recipient perpetually or for a fixed term, regardless of transaction characterization; the final condition is the express exception.

obligation_items.content: Accompany the Corresponding Source conveyed under section 6 with Installation Information sufficient for installing and executing modified versions from modified Corresponding Source in the User Product.
obligation_items.object: Corresponding Source and Installation Information for the covered work in the User Product
obligation_items.trigger: When the actor conveys object-code work under section 6 in, with, or specifically for a User Product as part of a transaction transferring possession and use rights perpetually or for a fixed term, unless neither the actor nor any third party can install modified object code on the User Product.

clauses.scope_note: GPL-3.0 section 6: this passage limits the Installation Information duty and permits denial of network access in the stated circumstances; it does not impose a continuing support, warranty, or update duty.
clauses.condition_explanation: The permission concerns denying network access where the modification itself materially and adversely affects network operation or violates communication rules or protocols. The passage does not identify a specific network operator; that actor label describes the party controlling network access.

obligation_items.content: Do not deny network access on the basis of a modification unless the modification itself materially and adversely affects network operation or violates the rules and protocols for communication across the network.
obligation_items.object: Network access for the modified work or User Product
obligation_items.trigger: When network access is denied because the work or User Product has been modified.

clauses.scope_note: GPL-3.0 section 6: applies to Corresponding Source conveyed and Installation Information provided in accordance with that section.
clauses.condition_explanation: The format must be publicly documented, have an implementation available to the public in source-code form, and require no special password or key for unpacking, reading, or copying.

obligation_items.content: Provide the Corresponding Source and Installation Information in a publicly documented format with an implementation available to the public in source-code form, requiring no special password or key for unpacking, reading, or copying.
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever Corresponding Source is conveyed or Installation Information is provided in accordance with GPL-3.0 section 6.

clauses.scope_note: GPL-3.0 section 7: additional permissions supplement the License by making exceptions from one or more conditions. Permissions applicable to the entire Program are treated as included in the License only to the extent valid under applicable law. If permissions apply only to part, that part may be used separately under them, while the entire Program remains governed by GPL-3.0 without regard to those part-only permissions.
clauses.condition_explanation: additional_permissions_apply_to_program_or_part means additional terms supplement the GPL by making exceptions from one or more GPL conditions. The whole-Program path is limited by validity under applicable law; the part-only path permits separate use of that part under those permissions and does not displace GPL-3.0 for the entire Program.

clauses.scope_note: GPL-3.0 section 7: on conveying a copy, the actor may remove additional permissions from the copy or any part; additional permissions may themselves require removal in specified modification cases. The actor may place additional permissions on material the actor adds only where the actor has or can give appropriate copyright permission.
clauses.condition_explanation: The option to remove additional permissions arises when conveying a copy of a covered work. The separate authority to add permissions is limited to material added by the actor and subject to the actor having or being able to give appropriate copyright permission.

clauses.scope_note: GPL-3.0 section 7: additional permissions may be placed on material added by the actor to a covered work, subject to appropriate copyright permission. Any applicable additional permission may itself require removal in certain modification cases.
clauses.condition_explanation: appropriate_copyright_permission_for_added_material means the actor has or can give appropriate copyright permission for the added material.

clauses.scope_note: GPL-3.0 section 7: for material added to a covered work, and only if authorized by its copyright holders, the actor may supplement the GPL terms with the specified additional terms. The listed possible terms include warranty/liability terms, preservation of specified reasonable notices or attributions, origin and modification marking, publicity-name limits, trademark-rights reservations, and narrowly triggered indemnification. The warranty/liability option is not separately extracted as an activity constraint.
clauses.condition_explanation: authorized_by_copyright_holders_of_added_material means the copyright holders of the added material authorize supplementing the terms. The indemnification term described at lines 382-386 is limited to a person conveying the material or modified versions with contractual assumptions of liability to the recipient, and to liability those assumptions directly impose on the licensors or authors.

obligation_items.content: Preserve specified reasonable legal notices or author attributions in the added material or in Appropriate Legal Notices displayed by works containing it, if that additional term is imposed.
obligation_items.actor: conveyer or other person to whom the additional term applies
obligation_items.object: Added material or Appropriate Legal Notices displayed by works containing it
obligation_items.trigger: When an authorized additional term under GPL-3.0 section 7(b) imposes preservation of specified reasonable legal notices or author attributions.

obligation_items.content: Do not misrepresent the origin of the added material and mark modified versions in reasonable ways as different from the original, if those additional terms are imposed.
obligation_items.actor: person using or modifying the added material
obligation_items.object: Added material and modified versions of it
obligation_items.trigger: When an authorized additional term under GPL-3.0 section 7(c) imposes the relevant origin or marking requirement.

obligation_items.content: Do not use licensors' or authors' names for publicity purposes to the extent an authorized additional term limits that use.
obligation_items.object: Names of licensors or authors of the added material
obligation_items.trigger: When an authorized additional term under GPL-3.0 section 7(d) limits publicity use of those names.

obligation_items.content: Indemnify licensors and authors for liability directly imposed on them by the person's contractual assumptions of liability to the recipient, if that additional term is imposed.
obligation_items.actor: person conveying the material or modified versions with contractual assumptions of liability to the recipient
obligation_items.object: Liability directly imposed on licensors or authors by those contractual assumptions
obligation_items.trigger: Only when the person conveys the material or modified versions with contractual assumptions of liability to the recipient and an authorized additional term under GPL-3.0 section 7(f) requires indemnification.

clauses.scope_note: GPL-3.0 section 7: a received Program or part bearing the specified GPL-plus-further-restriction notice may have that term removed. Material governed by another license document containing a further restriction may be added to a covered work when that document permits GPL relicensing or conveying, only if the further restriction does not survive that relicensing or conveying.
clauses.condition_explanation: A further restriction is a non-permissive additional term as described in section 7. The two paths are alternatives: removal of a term from the received Program or part, or addition of material under the described other license document subject to non-survival of the restriction.

obligation_items.content: Do not retain the further restriction when adding material under the other license document to a covered work through GPL relicensing or conveying, if that restriction would survive.
obligation_items.object: Material governed by the other license document and the further restriction
obligation_items.trigger: When that license document contains a further restriction, permits relicensing or conveying under GPL-3.0, and the restriction would otherwise survive such relicensing or conveying.

clauses.scope_note: GPL-3.0 section 7: adding terms to a covered work is conditioned on placing the required notice in relevant source files.
clauses.condition_explanation: The condition applies when terms are added to a covered work in accordance with section 7. The notice may either state the additional terms that apply to those files or indicate where to find the applicable terms.

obligation_items.content: Place in relevant source files either a statement of the additional terms that apply to those files or a notice indicating where to find the applicable terms.
obligation_items.object: relevant source files of the covered work
obligation_items.trigger: The licensee adds terms to a covered work in accordance with section 7.

clauses.scope_note: GPL-3.0 section 8: a covered work may not be modified except as expressly provided by the License. An attempt otherwise is void and automatically terminates the licensee's rights, including the referenced section 11 patent licenses.
clauses.condition_explanation: A covered work is the Program or a work based on the Program. The prohibition applies when the particular modification is not expressly provided for under the License.

obligation_items.content: Do not modify the covered work except as expressly provided under the License.
obligation_items.trigger: The proposed modification is not expressly provided under the License.

clauses.scope_note: GPL-3.0 section 8: a covered work may not be propagated except as expressly provided by the License. An attempt otherwise is void and automatically terminates the licensee's rights, including the referenced section 11 patent licenses.
clauses.condition_explanation: A covered work is the Program or a work based on the Program. Propagation has the meaning supplied by the License; the prohibition applies when the particular propagation is not expressly provided for under the License.

obligation_items.content: Do not propagate the covered work except as expressly provided under the License.
obligation_items.trigger: The proposed propagation is not expressly provided under the License.

clauses.scope_note: GPL-3.0 section 8: upon cessation of all violations, the license from the particular copyright holder is reinstated provisionally, unless explicitly and finally terminated, and permanently if that holder fails to give reasonable notice before 60 days after cessation.
clauses.condition_explanation: Cessation of all violations is required. The outcomes are alternatives: provisional reinstatement subject to explicit and final termination, or permanent reinstatement if the holder fails to give reasonable notice before the 60-day deadline. This clause describes license status, not a duty to use the work.

clauses.scope_note: GPL-3.0 section 8: permanent reinstatement applies when the same copyright holder gives reasonable notice, it is the first notice of a License violation for any work from that holder, and the violation is cured before 30 days after receipt.
clauses.condition_explanation: All three predicates are required; the 30-day period runs from receipt of notice. This clause describes license status, not a duty to use the work.

clauses.scope_note: GPL-3.0 section 8: termination of the licensee's rights does not terminate licenses of parties who received copies or rights from that licensee under the License.
clauses.condition_explanation: Applies to recipients who received copies or rights under the License; it does not state that the terminated licensee retains rights.

clauses.scope_note: GPL-3.0 section 8: a licensee whose rights are terminated and not permanently reinstated does not qualify to receive new licenses for the same material under section 10.
clauses.condition_explanation: Both termination and absence of permanent reinstatement are required. The clause states ineligibility for a new section 10 license for the same material.

clauses.scope_note: GPL-3.0 section 9: acceptance is not required merely to receive or run a copy. This does not grant propagation or modification rights apart from the License; modifying or propagating indicates acceptance.
clauses.condition_explanation: The permission is limited to receiving or running a copy without acceptance. Propagation or modification is separately governed by the License, and undertaking either indicates acceptance to do so.

clauses.scope_note: GPL-3.0 section 9: ancillary propagation occurring solely as a consequence of using peer-to-peer transmission to receive a copy does not require acceptance.
clauses.condition_explanation: The exception is limited to ancillary propagation solely resulting from peer-to-peer transmission used to receive the copy; it does not grant other propagation or modification rights.

clauses.scope_note: GPL-3.0 section 10: each conveyance automatically gives the recipient a license from the original licensors to run, modify, and propagate the covered work, subject to the License. The conveying licensee is not responsible for enforcing third-party compliance.
clauses.condition_explanation: A covered work is the Program or a work based on the Program; conveyance enables other parties to make or receive copies. The automatic grant is not a separate licensee duty to issue a sublicense.

clauses.scope_note: GPL-3.0 section 10 expressly states that the conveying licensee is not responsible for enforcing third-party compliance with the License.
clauses.condition_explanation: Applies to third parties who receive the covered work; no enforcement duty is imposed on the conveying licensee.

clauses.scope_note: GPL-3.0 section 10: for propagation resulting from an entity transaction, each transaction party receiving a copy receives the specified predecessor licenses and a right to possession of Corresponding Source if the predecessor has it or can obtain it with reasonable efforts.
clauses.condition_explanation: An entity transaction means transfer of control of an organization or substantially all its assets, subdivision of an organization, or merger of organizations. The licenses and source-possession right are distinct consequences; the source right is limited by the stated availability and reasonable-efforts condition.

clauses.scope_note: GPL-3.0 section 10: no further restriction may be imposed on exercise of License rights. Examples include charging a license fee, royalty, or other charge for exercising those rights, and initiating patent-infringement litigation over making, using, selling, offering for sale, or importing the Program or a portion.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition concerns restrictions on exercise of rights granted or affirmed under the License; it is not a general prohibition on charging for unrelated goods or services. The patent-litigation example covers the specified acts and Program subject matter.

obligation_items.content: Do not impose further restrictions on exercise of rights granted or affirmed under the License, including a license fee, royalty, or other charge for exercising those rights.
obligation_items.object: rights granted or affirmed under the License in the covered work
obligation_items.trigger: The proposed restriction would apply to exercise of rights granted or affirmed under the License.

obligation_items.content: Do not initiate patent-infringement litigation alleging infringement by making, using, selling, offering for sale, or importing the Program or any portion of it.
obligation_items.object: Program or any portion of it
obligation_items.trigger: The proposed litigation alleges infringement by one or more of the specified acts.

coverage_notes: The extracted text does not supply any particular additional permissions, additional terms, other license document, or further-restriction notice; those remain conditional on the stated facts and are not presumed to exist.

The section 6 source-provision requirement is cross-referenced as applying to Corresponding Source conveyed under that section; the full earlier source-conveyance alternatives are outside this target chunk.

Section 10 lines 453–461 define entity transaction and state conditional license and Corresponding Source possession consequences. The source-possession right depends on the predecessor having or being able to obtain the Corresponding Source with reasonable efforts.

Section 11 begins at line 471, but its operative patent provisions are outside this target chunk. The section 8 reference to termination of patent licenses and section 10 patent-litigation restriction are captured only to the extent stated here.
